bar: Chop the head off of yo body
chip_form: Chop the head off of yo body
note_excerpt: Chief Keef shot someone and missed their head, so to finish them off he chopped their head off, and afterwards went to a shooting range to practice his aim so this type of thing wouldn’t happen again.
The producer of this song is Diamond Pistols, known for frequently collaborating with bbno$, a friend of Yung Gravy, Tiny Meat Gang, Rich Brian, and Yung Gravy himself.
